infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly connects to nearby ADS-B receivers to show live traffic.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly uses your location to show live flight stats and nearby airports.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly uses the camera so you can capture profile photos and upload aircraft, ID, and certification documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly uses your photo library so you can upload profile photos, aircraft images, and verification documents.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly uses Bluetooth to connect to nearby aviation devices such as ADS-B receivers for live traffic data.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Ready Set Fly uses Bluetooth to communicate with nearby aviation hardware devices.
